parameters.content:
## Samsung — RAG Indexing (Phase 3B)

**Document/chunk construction is NOT done in this workflow.** It is done by the already-tested, deterministic Python package `projects/samsung-ai-consultant/indexing/` (`python -m indexing build --product-id <id>`), run as a separate step before this workflow.

Why: the n8n container (`docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n`) has no Python runtime (confirmed via `docker exec ... which python3` → not found), and this repository is not mounted into it (confirmed via `docker inspect` — only `/files` and the n8n data volume are mounted). Making Python callable from inside n8n would require a Docker/compose image or mount change, which is explicitly out of scope for this phase (stop-and-report first, not just do it).

So the integration boundary is **the database**: Python writes `documents`/`chunks` rows with `content`, `content_hash`, `metadata`, and `embedding = NULL`. This workflow's job starts there — it finds chunks with `embedding IS NULL` and fills them in via a real OpenAI embeddings call. Nothing here reimplements the document/chunk text-building logic in JavaScript.

See `projects/samsung-ai-consultant/workflows/README.md` for the full design writeup.

## Safety gate — single product only

`Indexing scope` below is deliberately hardcoded to one real product (`QE65S95HAUXPY`) for the Phase 3B acceptance test.

**Do not blank/remove this filter to run the full catalog** without explicit re-approval — that is a deliberate future step (Phase 3B full-catalog indexing), reviewed separately per the task brief's review gate. Widening scope is a one-line edit to `Indexing scope` and to the `p.model_code = '...'` filter in `Count pending chunks` / `Get chunks pending embedding` / `Run summary` — not a redesign.

parameters.query:
SELECT count(*)::int AS pending_count
FROM chunks c
JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id
WHERE c.embedding IS NULL
  AND p.model_code = '{{ $json.target_model_code }}';

SELECT
  c.id AS chunk_id,
  c.document_id,
  c.product_id,
  c.content,
  p.model_code
FROM chunks c
JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id
WHERE c.embedding IS NULL
  AND p.model_code = '{{ $('Indexing scope').item.json.target_model_code }}'
ORDER BY c.id;

assignments.name: note
assignments.value: No chunks with embedding IS NULL for this product -- either already fully embedded, or documents/chunks haven't been built yet via `python -m indexing build`.

parameters.query:
UPDATE chunks
SET embedding = '{{ $json.embedding_literal }}'::vector,
    embedding_model = '{{ $json.embedding_model }}'
WHERE id = {{ $json.chunk_id }};

SELECT
  p.model_code,
  count(*) AS total_chunks,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.embedding IS NOT NULL) AS embedded_chunks,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.embedding IS NULL) AS pending_chunks
FROM chunks c
JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id
WHERE p.model_code = '{{ $('Indexing scope').item.json.target_model_code }}'
GROUP BY p.model_code;
